bodyAppend: Use the classification results to identify menu items that contribute to profit and inform decisions to improve the restaurant’s overall profit margin. Classification alone does not automatically produce improvement.

question.prompt: After classifying menu items with ABC analysis, which use of the results matches the purpose stated in the lesson?
choices: Assume that making a classification table always raises the profit margin without further action
Judge every contribution to profit solely by sales volume
Identify contributions to profit and use them to inform decisions to improve the restaurant’s overall profit margin
Make all products identical without checking the purpose of the classification
question.explanation: ABC classification results help identify menu items that generate profit and support improvements to the restaurant’s profit margin. Creating a classification table alone does not guarantee automatic results.
